name: local-skills
description: Personal collection of Claude Code skills.

plugins.name: bump-homebrew
plugins.description: Automate releasing a new Homebrew formula version — tags the repo, builds a deterministic tarball, uploads a GitHub Release asset, and updates the formula.

plugins.name: chart-viz
plugins.description: Manual-only chart decision framework, invoked with /chart-viz. Resolves chart type, color, decluttering, emphasis, and sorting against the question, data shape, medium, and audience rather than applying a fixed checklist.

plugins.name: dashboard-design
plugins.description: Apply expert dashboard design principles when building, auditing, or critiquing dashboards and data tables — enforces data-driven form, progressive disclosure, and invisible UI.

plugins.name: design-loop
plugins.description: Manual-only design critic loop, invoked with /design-loop. Takes a goal and a real-world reference, tears the reference down into checkable mechanisms, then runs a builder and three fresh-context critics (brief, system, craft) on every piece until all three agree ours wins.

plugins.name: extract-dna
plugins.description: Manual-only design DNA extraction, invoked with /extract-dna. Measures one design system — screenshot, URL, PDF, video/GIF, code/CSS, or design file, one sample or several of the same system — into a dna.json record and a dna.md guide, proven complete by rebuilding the reference and diffing it numerically.

plugins.name: jpeg-concat
plugins.description: Join JPEG images side-by-side or stacked while matching the source encoding parameters, keeping file sizes close to the sum of the inputs.

plugins.name: mobile-screen-design
plugins.description: Manual-only mobile screen design pass, invoked with /mobile-screen-design. Reviews or builds any mobile app screen in two passes: a defect pass (overlay contrast, media style-consistency, icon axes, mutable state in copy, decision order, action grouping, label/accessibility splits) then a flow pass (scroll context, sticky actions, common-case presets). Rules are graded by evidence strength against Apple HIG, Material, WCAG, and NN/g.

plugins.name: pdf-to-md
plugins.description: Convert a PDF, a page range, or one section of it to markdown that keeps the merged-cell tables intact, then verify against the source that no text was lost.

plugins.name: plan-interview
plugins.description: Walk through a space of interconnected decisions via structured interview — useful when the path forward is unclear and you need to resolve trade-offs before acting.

plugins.name: plan-relax
plugins.description: Run a relaxed, low-pressure decision interview to think through interconnected choices with trade-offs.

plugins.name: to-prd
plugins.description: Turn the current conversation context into a PRD grounded in existing decision logs, without re-interviewing the user.

plugins.name: tufte-clarity
plugins.description: Apply Tufte's information design principles to UI layouts, web pages, and presentation slides — reduces chrome, improves signal density.

plugins.name: tufte-viz
plugins.description: Ideate and critique data visualizations using Tufte's principles: data-ink ratio, chartjunk elimination, graphical integrity, and small multiples.

plugins.name: worktree-swarm
plugins.description: Split a multi-part fix/feature into worktree-isolated subagents run in parallel, then manually integrate and verify the results.
